primaryTheorem.location: Theorem A, page117; normalization discussion pages120-121
primaryTheorem.finding: The target is a regular algebraic cuspidal GL(n+1) automorphic lift for each positive symmetric order of a non-CM regular algebraic cuspidal GL2 representation over Q. Local parameters must match at every place. Its normalization uses geometric Frobenius. Constructing homogeneous diagonal determinants establishes a local normalization step, not the asserted global lifts.

externalLeanReview.finding: The inspected upstream file defines a restricted rank-two automorphic condition through weight-two quaternionic forms. It is a potential source of foundations, not a proof of the required all-order Newton–Thorne theorem. Search results did not establish an available audited implementation of that theorem. No external Lean code was imported.

externalScopeStatement.finding: The upstream roadmap distinguishes reductions using major mathematical inputs from proving all such inputs. Any future reuse must inspect the exact statement, pinned revision, proof body and complete dependency closure.
